verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page explicitly claims automated change approval and mapping incidents to deployments, but only together with Jira Service Management, a separate product. Supporting claims cover change-management workflow enforcement, deployment environments and environment-level permissions. All evidence is marketing-level copy. Missing for 10: native capability without the add-on Jira Service Management product, in-depth documentation of how approval gates block releases, independent or hands-on corroboration.
